name: Algaz Station
summary: Algaz Station is a dwarven military outpost situated in northwestern Loch Modan, directly south of the fortified pass of Dun Algaz. Manning the approach to the northern tunnels, its garrison of Mountaineers helps safeguard travelers and watch the frontier leading toward the Wetlands.

sections.title: Watching the Northern Pass
sections.body: Perched just east of North Gate Pass and south of Dun Algaz, Algaz Station serves as a vital strategic watchpoint for the kingdom of Ironforge. A cadre of dwarven Mountaineers maintains a permanent vigil here, keeping the vital road between Loch Modan and the northern lowlands open to trade and troop movements. Given the frequent threats in the surrounding hills, from wandering beasts to encroaching troggs, the outpost provides respite, repairs, and martial support for weary travelers before they venture through the mountain tunnels.

faq.answer: It is an Ironforge military outpost in northwestern Loch Modan. It serves as a guard post and waystation for Mountaineers patrolling the mountain passes leading north to Dun Algaz.

faq.q: Where does the station get its name?
aliases: why is it called algaz station
faq.answer: It takes its name from Dun Algaz, the massive dwarven pass and tunnel system situated just north of the station that connects Loch Modan to the Wetlands.

faq.q: Who can be found at Algaz Station?
faq.answer: The outpost is manned by dwarven Mountaineers, including Mountaineer Stormpike, alongside support personnel like the armorer Gothor Brumn who provides field repairs to travelers.

angles.text: For dwarven travelers, Algaz Station is a familiar emblem of Ironforge's reach, ensuring the king's highways remain guarded against threats spilling from the mountains.
The outpost offers a secure staging ground and repair stop for Alliance adventurers journeying between Loch Modan and the marshlands of the north.
